scheme_name: Goa Welfare / Pension Scheme For Seafarers
other_conditions: Must be a citizen of India
Must be a retired seaman who was employed on board a ship
Seamen invalidated from sea service on medical grounds before retirement are also eligible
Retired seaman must have rendered a total of 120 months of actual service on board the ship (a break of up to 6 months is allowed)
Widow of a deceased seaman is eligible on compassionate grounds provided she has been a resident of Goa for 15 years and her annual income does not exceed ₹1,20,000
Beneficiary must be a bonafide resident of Goa by birth, or have birth registered in Goa, or have at least one parent born in Goa
benefits_summary: Provides a gross pension of ₹2,500 per month (or only the difference if the applicant already receives a lower pension under other schemes).
